notes.title: Regular Update 1
notes.content:
Improved task indicator: now it "sticks" to the edge of the screen and points towards the target.

Added indicators for the "grenade throw" and "healing point" abilities. If the target point is outside the 
screen, the indicator will also "stick" to the edge of the screen.

Fixed all hitboxes for cursor interactions: no more pixel-hunting to select cover, weapons, or enemies.

Improved HUD interaction: mouse clicks no longer pass through the minimap and unit cards.

Enhanced unit movement system: units now maintain formation and avoid getting stuck on level objects.

Improved cover system: all selected units will now move towards cover, even if there is no room for them.

Added a rank system for units: units gain combat experience and become more effective in battle.

Added animated event indication on the minimap.

Fixed several bugs and optimized game performance.

notes.title: Month 1 Patch - plans
notes.content:
Dear Friends, we want to share with you the plans of our work for the first month after the release.
Tasks for Month 1 Patch (fixes and improvements)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/5b3be82442cdf6a5c5a7ddce6f7bca7b82d62b30.jpg[/img]

Backlog

Enemy Ai improvements

UI improvements

Level Game Context Refactoring

Save system development


InProgress

Unit Movement Improvements

Steam achievements with progress


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/a1837b69bd5e3a7f66f39aed142f9dfc872bc160.png[/img]

Done - It will be added soon

Minor bug fixes

Out of screen task marker added

Out of screen ability marker added (grenades, heal spot)

Units & interactables hitbox for mouse clicks improvements


Dear friends! We examined the feedback from all possible resources and adjusted the development plan to suit the feedback of our audience. Now we will try to fix critical errors with the movement of units and improve the system of formations and shelters, and then we will move on to adding a skirmish mode.


We took reviews and feedback from reviews on Steam, Discord, personal messages by email and comments on YouTube.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/0fc1fe3fa77e143fc2831151d7145092852c0e28.png[/img]

Thank you for your honesty, sincerity and for giving us a chance!

Also, do not forget that everyone who bought the game has a comic inside the extra content folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/29254fb9584308767982e70f6ab65a52957d402d.png[/img]

notes.title: Roadmap and big updates
notes.content:
[b]Hey friends![/b]

 As the game's Early Access launch approaches, we're delighted to unveil the Ratten Reich roadmap, packed with fantastic features and plans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/e49be07fda7827863cd678b607e0d80a13843d7d.jpg[/img]

Come chat and discuss what you're excited for and stay tuned for more updates! And for those of you who've been part of our closed testing, we're rolling out another build to polish up any remaining details. 

Now it's worth talking about our in-game updates.


[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Hotkeys for unit and ability management

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/857c5fbd1f220dc01a35f9b848b2f09d3d2cff5b.png[/img]

[*] Added session statistics for players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/5586487573d0c154f0396c1746fba1604e7c50bb.png[/img]

[*] Tracers added to all bullets
[*] New voiceover added to the Archipelago map
[*] Started development on the "Desert Storm" map
[*] Rally Point: You can now place a rally point near a captured base where new hired fighters will gather.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/00ee66ec8ff21e22043b8b4b8ef3af7395dac0b4.png[/img]

[*] Patrolling: Enemy units now patrol the territory.
[*] Scripted Combat Vehicles: Vehicles that move along a predetermined route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/77d4846d14596a79b758d36864954cf7e0e18e21.png[/img]

[*] Unit Markers Added: For better readability on the game location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/24be841128ebef80f56efea76f5a154c3edf1c66.png[/img]

[*] Resource Cap Added: A limit on the maximum available amount of resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/9bc657764cbb8abd7960911773453800701abed8.png[/img]

[*] Unit Cap on Map Added: A limit on the maximum number of units on the map.
[*] Trap Mechanics Added: Including mines and tripwires.
[*] More Random Events on Map Added.
[/list]


[b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved level design of the "Archipelago" and "Swamp" maps
[*] Updated design of ability indicators:
[*] Grenades
[*] Air Strike
[*] Enemy artillery attack
[*] Additional indication for available stationary guns
[*] Additional light indication for active grenades
[*] Fixed weapon grip for heavy machine gunners
[*] Minor enhancements to AI behavior
[*] Fixed Several Critical and Minor Bugs.
[*] Significant Optimization: The project has been significantly optimized for better performance.
[*] Improved Enemy Unit Reaction to Threats.
[*] UI Targeting Now Indicates Multiple Targets.
[*] Corrected Grenade Flight Trajectory.
[*] Fixed Issue with Incorrect Display of Active Buff and Debuff Effects.
[*] Fixed Pistol Shooting Animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Hi everyone, we want to share some new updates and fixes to our project.
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone, we want to share some new updates and fixes to our project.[/b]
A few innovations and many small and large fixes

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New Map: Level 0 - Training Level
[*] Training Level Events Logic
[*] Added new music for the Asian company
[*] Added ERS faction as player-controlled units
[*] Added RD faction as units under enemy AI control
[*] Added an amphibious APC wheeled combat vehicle as a unit under enemy AI control
[*] Updated the design of unit cards in the game UI
[*] Added X-RAY effect for cases when units are blocked by obstacles

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/bc645b4e2432b88b8ae83baf6389d350e84f1da9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/bc645b4e2432b88b8ae83baf6389d350e84f1da9.gif[/img][/url]

[*] A unit can now only be in one fixed squad, not several at once
[*] Added additional animated low health indication for player units
[*] Added destination point markers when commanding units to move
[*] The formation system has been completely redesigned
[*] Added burst firing for automatic rifle guns
[*] The mortar now fires three consecutive shots instead of one
[*] Rotate units formation via hold rmb

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/7b2625587217b3e59f63cd00c884b20f89a3749e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/7b2625587217b3e59f63cd00c884b20f89a3749e.gif[/img][/url]

[*] Added the ability to rotate the camera using the Q and E keys
[*] Added ability to select all units simultaneously using CTRL+A key combination
[*] Added indicators-icons over artillery guns

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/c0f0317025d00233c024c460880eb4276bf50a35.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/c0f0317025d00233c024c460880eb4276bf50a35.gif[/img][/url]

[*] Added debuff effect of slowing down the speed of movement of units in difficult conditions (water, mud, climbs, thickets, etc.)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/333a92d313c9ffe8eec9fa7c7e83d2d3056483ae.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/333a92d313c9ffe8eec9fa7c7e83d2d3056483ae.gif[/img][/url]

[/list]

[b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 1-2 – localization fix
[*] Level 1-2 – side quest award fix
[*] The heal point (medic ability) now heals units that are in a delineated area, rather than all over the map.
[*] Solved issue with grenade disappearing
[*] Grenade damage calculation upgrade
[*] AI behavior improved
[*] Improved rendering of prediction trajectory and damage area for grenades
[*] Improved grenade physics on contact with surfaces - now the grenade does not bounce off the ground
[*] Fixed calculation of acutal grenades in the ability widget
[*] Removed the unit stamina feature
[*] Reworked small arms firing logic from projektails to raycasts
[*] VFX of small arms firing has been redesigned
[*] Fixed problems when spawning enemy units
[*] Fixed problems with selecting single units by mouse click
[*] Fixed a problem caused by a broken animation of putting on a gas mask
[*] Fixed a crash when leaving artillery
[*] Fixed problems with cover points
[*] Improved the logic of bullet hitting effects on different types of surfaces
[/list]
